mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month indicates strengthening residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and thus drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle, which compresses equity discount rates and thus drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) from the prior month indicates a weakening labor market and manufacturing sector, which together signal an economic contraction and thus drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between the joint signal (UNRATE increase and INDPRO decline) and 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 280), a decline in real sales (RSAFS) relative to the prior month indicates weakening consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between the joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 280 and RSAFS decline) and 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior month indicates strengthening manufacturing output, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and thus drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic conditions, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in UNRATE < 4.0% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) from the prior month indicates weakening consumer and residential demand, which together signal an economic slowdown and thus drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between the joint signal (RSAFS decline and HOUST decline) and 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annually), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior month indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which together signal an economic slowdown and thus drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between the joint signal (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% and INDPRO decline) and 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
